ItemID: unavailable; Title: John Denver: The WILDlife Concert; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The folk sound fits my Simon & Garfunkel listening, but I would choose a studio collection before a live concert today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Blues Of Desperation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar oldies and melodic classic rock than a blues-focused album right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazing Early 60s Box: 88 Hard-To-Find Hits / Various; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This strongly matches my interest in AM Gold and older hits, with a chance to rediscover songs I have forgotten.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Poems, Prayers and Promises; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its gentle folk songwriting appeals to the side of my taste reflected in Jonathan Edwards and Simon & Garfunkel.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 1 Remixed/Remastered; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This looks promising given my interest in Beatles recordings, but I would confirm the artist and track list before choosing it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Very Best Of Fleetwood Mac; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A familiar classic-rock hits collection fits my recent pattern of choosing accessible retrospectives.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Rick Nelson - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: His melodic oldies fit the early-to-mid-1960s listening I have enjoyed through compilations.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Remasters; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me enough about the artist or songs to make this a choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Essential Sarah McLachlan; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I can appreciate reflective pop, but I am more drawn to older folk and classic-rock favorites today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: 5 Original Albums; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need the artist and album titles before committing to a five-album set.
